entities.summary: Belgian Revolution of 1830, a transformative movement in Belgium (1815–1839). Emerged from Treaty of London and Austrian Habsburg & French Revolutionary Period. Catalyzed Treaty of London guarantees Belgian independence and neutrality and Belgian Revolution begins at Brussels opera house.
